title: backlog.py's usage text for precheck omits a bug's repro and the time-windowed detector warning
goal: bl_land.precheck now runs a bug's repro and warns of a check or repro that is the intake --status of a time-windowed detector (tools.md and backlog.md say so), but the precheck entry of backlog.py's module usage text still says only 'run each committed item's checks once ... of each that passes already'. The entry names the bug repro and the windowed-detector warning, as the docs do.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import backlog;d=backlog.__doc__;i=d.index('backlog.py precheck');e=d[i:d.index('backlog.py close SPRINT')];sys.exit(0 if 'repro' in e and 'time-windowed' in e else 1)
